'''Kerane Valley''' was a valley on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], located east of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]], between [[Moorsh Moraine/Legends|Moorsh Moraine]] and the [[Nev Ice Flow/Legends|Nev Ice Flow]]. [[Blizzard Force/Legends|Blizzard Force]] went through this treacherous valley to get to Echo Base during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Starck/Legends|Starck's]] [[Blizzard 4/Legends|Blizzard 4]] would attempt to impress [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] by taking his group on a direct but dangerous route through the valley. The move resulted in the loss of three [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] to ice flows, and Starck was forced to regroup with the rest of the assault force.<ref name="ItWoSWT" />
